page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9ae.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz. The system features 256.0 GB of RAM, establishing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, which is designed to support memory-bound applications.

The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps to handle data transfers. No GPU accelerators are present on this hardware configuration, focusing resources entirely on CPU and memory capacity.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r9ae.8xlarge offers a dense memory configuration relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for workloads where memory capacity is the primary bottleneck. This resource balance is suitable for hosting in-memory databases, large-scale caching systems, enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, and memory-intensive data analytics pipelines.
